data_fields.name: town_errand_counted
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: not repeatable; not trainer; not group (suggestedPlayers); not instance kill; giver or turn-in inside hub; turn-in inside zone

data_fields.name: errand_skipped_when_unreachable
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: retired, or class-locked to another class, is skipped and not counted

data_fields.name: zone_done_text_present
data_fields.donor_constant: optional welcomeDone string per zone (three founding zones author it)

best_idea: A zone is done when every errand the town hands out and receives inside the zone is turned in, with retired or other-class quests skipped and a zone with zero counted errands never counted as done.
decision_why: Keep the completion rule and the done-line-over-welcome precedence; author the errand list per zone as data instead of inferring it from NPC positions, so a moved NPC cannot silently change the rule. The line is client HUD only, so any reward tied to it must move to the server.
acceptance: Entering a zone with a town-done line shows it only after the last counted errand is turned in; a retired or other-class errand does not block it; a zone with zero counted errands never shows it; a server-side test asserts the authored errand list matches the NPC positions.
